)

  local url="http://localhost:${port}/health"
  # Perform request silently, capture HTTP status code

  if [[ "$http_code" == "200" ]]; then
    echo "Port $port: OK (HTTP $http_code)"
    return 0
  else
    echo "Port $port: FAIL (HTTP $http_code)"
    return 1
  fi
}

check_port 3000 || status=1
check_port 8080 || status=1

else

fi

exit $status
